When hydrogen reacts with carbon dioxide in a sealed vessel at 130 °C using a suitable catalyst,
methanol is produced.
The equation is shown.
3H2(g)  +  CO2(g)
CH3OH(g)  +  H2O(g)
ΔH  =  – 40 kJ / mol
The activation energy, Ea, of the forward reaction is +220 kJ / mol.
